result.instructions: Tools for Qualio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the open CAPAs and nonconformances assigned to me."; "Which documents are waiting for approval right now?"; "Who is overdue on training for the current SOP revisions?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Qualio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run qualio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run qualio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run qualio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. qualio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: qualio_get_me
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Return the id and name of the user who owns this API token. Call it first to find your own user id for owner filters. Qualio API: GET /v1/user-management/user/me.

tools.name: qualio_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users in the company. Qualio API: GET /v1/user-management/users.

tools.name: qualio_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id. Qualio API: GET /v1/user-management/user/{userId}.

tools.name: qualio_list_groups
tools.title: List user groups
tools.description: List the user groups in the company. Qualio API: GET /v1/user-management/groups.

tools.name: qualio_list_group_users
tools.title: List users in a group
tools.description: List the users in one user group. Qualio API: GET /v1/user-management/groups/{groupId}/users.

tools.name: qualio_query_documents
tools.title: Query documents
tools.description: Find documents by status (required), optionally by tag names or template code prefixes. Use it for 'what is approved', 'what is for review' and similar questions. Qualio API: GET /v1/documents/query.

types.description: Document template code prefixes to filter by.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset).

tools.name: qualio_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one document's metadata (title, status, owners, reviewers, approvers). Qualio API: GET /v1/documents/document/{documentId}.

tools.name: qualio_get_document_content
tools.title: Get document content
tools.description: Get the sections and text of one document. Qualio API: GET /v1/documents/document/{documentId}/content.

tools.name: qualio_list_document_versions
tools.title: List document versions
tools.description: List the versions of one document. Qualio API: GET /v1/documents/document/{documentId}/versions.

tools.name: qualio_list_document_comments
tools.title: List document comments
tools.description: List the review comments on one document. Qualio API: GET /v1/documents/document/{documentId}/comments.

tools.name: qualio_list_document_templates
tools.title: List document templates
tools.description: List the document templates the company can use. Qualio API: GET /v1/documents/templates.

tools.name: qualio_query_events
tools.title: Query quality events
tools.description: List quality events (CAPAs, nonconformances, complaints and similar) by status, optionally by owner user id or event template. For 'open CAPAs assigned to me', pass status 'open' and owner_user_id from qualio_get_me. Qualio API: GET /v1/events/events.

owner_user_id.description: Only events owned by this user id.

event_template_matrix_id.description: Only events from this event template (matrix id).

offset.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset).

tools.name: qualio_get_event
tools.title: Get a quality event
tools.description: Get one quality event by its code (for example 'CAPA-12'). Qualio API: GET /v1/events/events/{code}.

code.description: Event code, including its type prefix (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: qualio_list_event_templates
tools.title: List event templates
tools.description: List the quality event templates (types of events the company runs). Qualio API: GET /v1/events/templates.

tools.name: qualio_create_event
tools.title: Create a quality event
tools.description: WRITE: create a new quality event from an event template. Creates a record that others see, so confirm the title and template first. Qualio API: POST /v1/events/events.

due_date.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later.

owner_user_id.description: Owner user id (must belong to this company).

tools.name: qualio_update_event
tools.title: Update a quality event
tools.description: WRITE: change the title, description, owner, severity or probability of one quality event. Only the fields you pass change. Qualio API: PATCH /v1/events/events/{code}.

code.description: Event code, including its type prefix (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: qualio_list_change_controls
tools.title: List change controls
tools.description: List change controls, optionally by status. Qualio API: GET /v1/change-management/change-controls.

orderBy.description: Field to order the results by.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset).

tools.name: qualio_get_change_control
tools.title: Get a change control
tools.description: Get one change control by id. Qualio API: GET /v1/change-management/change-controls/{id}.

change_control_id.description: Change control id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: qualio_list_change_requests
tools.title: List change requests
tools.description: List change requests, optionally by status. Qualio API: GET /v1/change-management/change-requests.

orderBy.description: Field to order the results by.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset).

tools.name: qualio_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers, optionally by approval status (for example REVIEW_PENDING or APPROVED). Qualio API: GET /v1/suppliers/suppliers.

status.description: Only suppliers with this status. Omit for all statuses.

tools.name: qualio_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by id. Qualio API: GET /v1/suppliers/suppliers/{supplierId}.

supplier_id.description: Supplier id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: qualio_list_frameworks
tools.title: List compliance frameworks
tools.description: List compliance frameworks (for example ISO 13485 or FDA QMSR), optionally by status. Qualio API: GET /v1/compliance/frameworks.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset).

tools.name: qualio_list_gaps
tools.title: List compliance gaps
tools.description: List compliance gaps, optionally by framework, status (open, resolved, dismissed) or severity (high, medium, low). Qualio API: GET /v1/compliance/gaps.

framework_id.description: Only gaps on controls linked to this framework id.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset).

tools.name: qualio_query_training
tools.title: Query training assignments
tools.description: List training assignments, optionally by document id, group id or status (due, overdue, complete). Use it for 'who is overdue on SOP X'. Qualio API: GET /v1/training/user-training/query.

include_removed.description: Include assignments completed and later unassigned.

include_inactive_users.description: Include users no longer active in the company.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset).

tools.name: qualio_get_training_stats
tools.title: Get company training statistics
tools.description: Get company-wide training statistics over a period in days (-1 for all time). Qualio API: GET /v1/training/stats.

period.description: Reporting period in days. Use -1 for all time.

tools.name: qualio_query_audit_trail
tools.title: Query the audit trail
tools.description: List the company audit trail (who did what, and when), filtered by user id and date range. Qualio API: GET /v1/audit-trail/audits.

user_id.description: Only activity by this user id.

start_date.description: Only activity from this date onwards (ISO 8601).

end_date.description: Only activity up to this date (ISO 8601).

offset.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset).

tools.name: qualio_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags used to label documents and events. Qualio API: GET /v1/tags/tags.

prompts.title: Get started with Qualio
